To initialize the Learning to Rank plugin, send the following request to your OpenSearch Service
domain:
PUT _ltr
{
"acknowledged" : true,
"shards_acknowledged" : true,
"index" : ".ltrstore"
}
This command creates a hidden .ltrstore index that stores metadata information such as
feature sets and models.
